sources.title: Owner-supplied Balatas Road canopy reference
sources.note: Inspected 2026-10-02. The initial dense road-covering draft is superseded by the owner request to reduce it. Retain spaced trees on both verges at roughly 40 m or greater along each side, with smaller estimated 11–14 m crowns and unchanged 8 m height. Chosen trunk positions and source routes remain; constrained gaps and clear road views are intentional. This is a schematic corridor, not a species or tree inventory.
